notes.title: Breaking Friendships Releasing on July 30th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197242/fa609a734fb78ad693ddf2e4a072e5df69e5e813.png[/img]

Celebrate [b]International Friendship Day[/b] on [b]July 30th[/b] by putting your friendship to the ultimate test during the the launch of "Breaking Friendships"!

Your goal is to prove to your friend or partner that you know them as well as you claim you do by correctly answering over 600 questions. 

The perfect opportunity to deepen your bond and discover just how well you truly know each other is right around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197242/b12905c75289df07e2ce528ec33d8298cbcfff56.png[/img]

Gather your best friend and get ready for the thrilling journey of exploring your emotional connection.
